input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The new Windows export tool almost certainly writes CRLF (`
`) line endings. `parseStatement` splits the input only on `"
"`, so each line (including the header) keeps a trailing `""`. That makes the last header column become `"description"` instead of `"description"`, so `assertShape`'s `REQUIRED_COLUMNS.some(column => !header.includes(column))` check fails on the very first call (`assertShape(header, header, 0)`), which is why the error always reports "row 1" regardless of the file's actual content. The fix should strip trailing `` from each line (or split on `/
|
/`) before parsing the header/fields.
